title: Reference links whose text contains inline code are not linked
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`. A reference-style link whose label contains backtick code is not turned into a link, even though the same text works as an inline link (`[some `Text`](http://example.com)`) and as a full reference link (`[some `Text`][ref]`). Input: ``` [`Text`] [`Text`]: http://example.com ``` Expected: `

Text

` Actual: `

[Text]

` The same happens when code is only part of the label, e.g. `[some `Text`]` or `[`Text` after]` with a matching definition; these should give `some Text` and `Text after`. A label with a single unmatched backtick (`[some `Text]`) already links correctly and should keep doing so.
acceptance: The reported input renders as a link containing the code
Shortcut reference links with code anywhere in the label are linked; unmatched backticks still work
